cases.name: Deborah Lee Atrops
cases.narrative:
On 12/1/1988, her body was found in the trunk of her car after a city public works employee reported a suspicious abandoned car with keys in the driver's seat and the vehicle’s driver's side window down. On the evening of Nov. 29, 1988, she was headed to a hair appointment in Tigard while her husband supposedly stayed home to care for their 8-month-old daughter. A missing persons report was filed the next day, and Atrops claimed he made several calls to friends, family and police from his house phone, but there was no record of those calls. 

She had been physically assaulted and strangled to death. Her death was ruled a homicide, though the case went cold, and no one was charged.
